scripts.kill-ports: pkill -9 -f workerd || true; pkill -9 -f miniflare || true; kill -9 $(lsof -t -i:8787 -i:8788 -i:9229 -i:9230 2>/dev/null) || true; sleep 2
scripts.ps-wrangler: ps aux | grep -E 'wrangler|miniflare|workerd' | grep -v grep || true
scripts.e2e: pnpm run kill-ports && pnpm run setup:db && ./qa/run_all_e2e.sh
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm run setup:db && pnpm run setup:kv && pnpm run setup:secrets
scripts.setup:wal: cd apps/public-api && npx wrangler d1 execute ecommerce-db --local --command "PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;" && cd ../admin-api && npx wrangler d1 execute ecommerce-db --local --persist-to=../public-api/.wrangler/state --command "PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;"
scripts.setup:db: cd apps/public-api && echo y | pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ecommerce-db --local && pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute ecommerce-db --local --file=seed.sql && cd ../admin-api && echo y | pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ecommerce-db --local --persist-to=../public-api/.wrangler/state && pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute ecommerce-db --local --persist-to=../public-api/.wrangler/state --file=../public-api/seed.sql
scripts.setup:kv: cd apps/public-api && npx wrangler kv:key put --binding=CACHE_KV "feature_flags" "{\"rma_self_service\": true}" --local --preview
scripts.setup:secrets: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['public-api', 'admin-api'].forEach(app => { const p = 'apps/'+app+'/.dev.vars'; if (!fs.existsSync(p)) fs.copyFileSync('apps/public-api/.dev.vars.example', p); })"
